cases.description: Learn Mara Vey's responsibility as Senior Archivist, including preservation or access procedures.

observations.text: Elena asks how the archive staff divide their responsibilities.

Finn tells Elena: 'Mara is the best archivist we've got. She oversees the preservation work, sets the document-handling rules, checks access requests, and directs the rest of us when there are problems. I handle digitization, and Voss is the curator.' Elena watches Mara correct Finn's handling of a fragile manuscript and instruct him to update the preservation log.

cases.description: Learn Mara Vey's responsibility as Senior Archivist, including preservation or access procedures.

observations.text: Elena asks how the archive staff divide their responsibilities.

Finn tells Elena: 'Mara works as an archivist here. She can help you find the public catalog.' Mara sits behind the reception desk, reminds Finn to keep the area tidy, and points Elena toward the reading room.

cases.description: Learn Mara Vey's responsibility as Senior Archivist, including preservation or access procedures.

observations.text: Elena asks how the archive staff divide their responsibilities.
Mara introduces herself to Elena: 'I am Mara Vey, the Senior Archivist. I supervise archival preservation and enforce the access procedures for our collections.'

cases.description: Learn Mara Vey's responsibility as Senior Archivist, including preservation or access procedures.

observations.text: Elena asks how the archive staff divide their responsibilities.

Finn initially introduces Mara as the archive's senior archivist, responsible for preservation and access. Mara immediately corrects him in Elena's presence: 'That is incorrect. I am an archivist who handles preservation records and explains access procedures. Director Thorne supervises our archival department. I do not hold its senior position.'
